issue_request: Published/Persuasive Vocab change request from STU3 asking to clarify VSD-3 for ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet when valueSet is combined with system plus concept or filter. The accepted resolution was to add a Composition Rules note explaining cumulative include union and within-include intersection, specifically for valueSet+system+filter or valueSet+system+concept combinations.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies git 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7. That commit changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to add explicit valueSet-only, system-only, and valueSet+system bullets, including the rule that system selection is applied after concept/filter and intersected with all referenced value sets. Current blame still ties the key composition-rule lines to that application commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists valueset=ValueSet and maps ValueSet to work group code vsd, so the inspected ValueSet source files are in current build scope. The originating Zulip thread records the same question and supports the interpretation that filter applies to the system and criteria within an include are intersections; empty intersections are not errors. A later nearby issue, FHIR-51117, clarified filter.value syntax only and does not alter the valueSet+system composition semantics.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml already says multiple includes are cumulative, criteria within one include intersect, valueSet-only includes require membership in all referenced value sets, and valueSet+System includes intersect code-system criteria after concept/filter with membership in all referenced value sets. source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml is consistent because ValueSet.compose.include says all include conditions must be true while retaining vsd-3.
